entries.description: Made in 2001 by Pamasol Willi Mäder AG, Switzerland Macine type: 2025/4A After the waterbath the cans move to the cap fitting. The machine places white caps to the cans and then presses them in place. The machine works pneumatically. Pamasol Willi Mäder AG is a Swiss aerosol company founded in 1965 by Willi Mäder. The firm has specialized in filling and sealing machines for aerosols and spray systems. Taerosol Oy is a finnish firm manufacturing technical aerosols for electronics and industries.
